_about: The organizations we follow. Hand-edited — this is the one file you touch for groups. Each entry: id (stable slug), name, what (why we care, one line), where (address or neighborhood), site, calendar (their own events page), feed (optional: how the build tool reads their calendar — type tribe|ics|jsonld|boswell|rss|uwm|uec|communico|brightspot (see tools/milwaukee/build.py for the rest); leave it out for link-only orgs), kind (default kind for their events when a listing gives no better clue: music theater comedy film art talks books markets outdoors food sports family community), reach (walk|bus|car from home, used the same way), tags. Optional knobs: kind_strict (always use the default kind, e.g. a bookstore), reach_strict (a campus: on campus unless the title is a trip out of town), cap (max events kept, default 80), and on the feed: exclude (title regex) and exclude_categories (listing-category regex), depts (uwm: the sub-site slugs). tools/milwaukee/build.py reads this and writes events.json; it never writes this file. Started 2026-09-13 from the old community/events notes — prune and add freely.

orgs.name: UWM Philosophy
orgs.what: Her department. Colloquia and talks, most in Curtin Hall.

orgs.name: UW–Milwaukee
orgs.what: The campus calendar, read department by department: Peck School concerts, plays and galleries, the Planetarium, the Libraries, the Union, the Graduate School, the colloquium series. Student-services noise is filtered out.

feed.exclude: orientation|enrollment|resume|application workshop|advising|drop-in hours|registration|deadline|office hours|training|tutoring|info session|information session|virtual|zoom|online|webinar|employee|staff |hiring|career fair|study abroad fair|financial aid|intramural|club (soccer|rugby|volleyball|basketball|hockey|baseball|softball|ultimate) home|prevent suicide|welcome back|help desk

orgs.name: Boswell Book Company
orgs.what: The East Side bookstore, a walk down Downer. Author events most nights; some move to the Riverside or the Oriental.

orgs.name: Urban Ecology Center
orgs.what: Riverside Park branch is the neighborhood's back yard, at the river end of Park Place. Volunteer days, birding, classes, family programs and outings at all three branches (Riverside Park, Washington Park, Menomonee Valley). Read from the public feed behind their calendar page.

orgs.name: Milwaukee Public Library
orgs.what: East Branch on Cramer is the local one; Central downtown is the grand one. Adult and all-ages programs at those two branches, read from their Communico calendar. Other branches and the kids' and teens' programs are left out: widen `locations` or `ages` on the feed to bring them in.

orgs.name: Milwaukee Film
orgs.what: Runs the Oriental on Farwell: the festival, repertory nights, year-round programming. Feed carries their announcements; showtimes are on the theatre page.

orgs.name: Milwaukee Art Museum
orgs.what: The Calatrava on the lake. Drop-in tours, talks, story time, MAM After Dark.

orgs.name: Woodland Pattern Book Center
orgs.what: Riverwest poetry and small-press center: readings, workshops, a reading group.

orgs.name: Milwaukee Turners
orgs.what: The 1853 gymnastics-and-democracy society at Turner Hall: climbing gym, public forums, the restaurant's fish fry. Nothing to read: their /events page is empty and their public Google calendar is only the citywide fitness-class schedule. Turner Hall Ballroom concerts arrive through Pabst Theater Group instead.
orgs.where: Turner Hall, 1034 N Vel R. Phillips Ave

orgs.name: Mitchell Park Domes
orgs.what: Three glass domes on the near South Side: shows, plant sales, the winter farmers market.

orgs.name: Historic Milwaukee, Inc.
orgs.what: Walking tours all year and Doors Open Milwaukee in late September (Sept 26 and 27, 2026). Tours book through FareHarbor, which only serves times to its own widget, so their page is the calendar. Doors Open tour slots still arrive through Eventbrite and UWM, and the yearly anchor is in season.json.

orgs.name: Milwaukee Makerspace
orgs.what: Member workshop in Bay View with public open nights. Feed carries their posts.

orgs.name: Radio Milwaukee 88Nine
orgs.what: The music station in Walker's Point: live sessions, a community calendar, the Fall Ball. Read from their community calendar's concert, festival, food and sports categories; the exhibits and classes that repeat daily are left out.
